name: MSR-VTT
description: A large-scale video-to-text benchmark containing short web video clips paired with natural-language captions, designed for video understanding and text generation research. This record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Xu, J., Mei, T., Yao, T., & Rui, Y. (2016). MSR-VTT: A Large Video Description Dataset for Bridging Video and Language. Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 5288–5296. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2016.571

license.identifier: Custom MSR-VTT dataset terms (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: The dataset is provided under custom terms rather than a standard SPDX-identified license. Review the upstream terms and rights for the underlying videos before use or redistribution; do not assume that video-content rights are transferred by dataset access.
